blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte “does not shrink from accountability, nor does she fear the outcome of this impeachment trial,” according to her lead defense counsel Shiela Sison. Sison made this comment after 13 senators voted to amend the July 6 ruling of Presiding Officer and Sen. Francis Escudero that two-thirds, or at least 16 votes of the 24 elected senators, are needed to convict the vice president.
